children: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII reported net income for the quarter, consisting of $2.1M in trust-account interest income offset by $395,884 in general and administrative costs. It has not begun operations and expects no operating revenue until completing a business combination.
: The company had not selected a target or engaged in substantive discussions with a target as of September 30.
: The balance was $246.7M, including $5.2M of interest income available for permitted withdrawals.
: The company had $372,369 in cash and $294,764 in working capital at September 30.
: Management said the company lacks liquidity to sustain operations for a year, raising substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
